findings.location: Informative Annex 3, §A3.3 (p226) — 'Preserved from Edition 1.7 without alteration' list, first item: 'The formatted Version 1 boundary row in Annex Table 3-1'
findings.observed: §A3.3 still lists the Version 1 boundary row in Annex Table 3-1 among items 'Preserved from Edition 1.7 without alteration', but the authorized second correction (authorized-change diff item #7) altered that row from 'OPEN / CLR-002 and CLR-042 unanswered' to 'PASS WITH RECORDED EXCEPTION / CLR-002 and CLR-042 resolved by founder decision (FD-001, FD-002)'. The §A3.3 sentence is byte-identical to the rejected candidate (was true there, is now false).
findings.required: The §A3.3 provenance list must not claim a row was preserved from Edition 1.7 without alteration when the Edition 1.9 correction altered that row; it should be reworded (or the boundary-row item removed) to agree with §A3.3a and Annex Table 3-1.
findings.why_it_matters: Internal-consistency / change-control accuracy defect within the authoring self-check annex: §A3.3 contradicts §A3.3a and the visible Annex Table 3-1 row about whether Edition 1.9 altered the boundary row. It does NOT misstate any register value or lifecycle status (every register/lifecycle fact is stated correctly document-wide), so it does not misrepresent the candidate's governance state to a reader. The correction editor did not disclose it, and the authorized-change diff's '0 unexplained' conclusion overlooks the consequential staleness.
findings.affected_category: evidence accuracy / change control (informative self-check annex)
findings.narrow_correction_scope: Reword the single §A3.3 list item to remove/qualify 'the formatted Version 1 boundary row in Annex Table 3-1', consistent with §A3.3a's disclosure that CLR-002/CLR-042 were resolved by FD-001/FD-002. Change no register value, no lifecycle status, no other text.
